zh.title: 致命地震十週後委內瑞拉主要機場恢復商業航班
zh.summary: 商業航班已重新返回卡拉卡斯；但委內瑞拉主要機場仍未完全恢復
body: 根據《Simple Flying》於2026年9月2日發布的報導，在遭遇致命地震襲擊的10週之後，委內瑞拉的主要機場已於當天重新恢復了商業航班的運作。這項最新的發展代表著，商業客運航班目前已經正式返回了卡拉卡斯地區。
不過，雖然商業客運航班此時已經重新返回卡拉卡斯，但該報導也明確指出，這座委內瑞拉最主要的機場目前的狀態依然尚未完全康復。目前，該機場整體的復原狀況距離完全恢復正常運作，仍然有著相當遙遠的距離。

en.title: Commercial Flights Return To Caracas Ten Weeks After Deadly Earthquakes
en.summary: Commercial flights return to Caracas; Venezuela's main airport remains far from fully recovered.
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on September 2, 2026, commercial flights have officially returned to Caracas, which is home to Venezuela's main airport. The resumption of commercial flights to the airport comes ten weeks after the area was struck by deadly earthquakes.

While commercial flights have successfully returned to Caracas, the report emphasizes that Venezuela's main airport remains far from fully recovered. Even though flights are operating again, the country's main airport is still described by Simple Flying as being far from a state of complete recovery.

zh.title: SAS於6個月內完成逾80架A320neo改裝Starlink
zh.summary: SAS於6個月內為80多架A320neo完成Starlink裝設
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，SAS 已在短短 6 個月的時間之內，成功為旗下超過 80 架 A320neo 客機完成 Starlink 衛星網路設備的安裝作業。
此項衛星通訊連結計畫以創紀錄的速度進行部署。隨著裝設完成，搭乘該機隊航班的常飛旅客將可獲得從登機閘門一直到降落閘門全程不間斷的高速影音串流服務。
除了閘門至閘門的無線影音串流服務外，該 Starlink 衛星連結系統亦為機上旅客提供迅速且高效的雲端資料存取體驗。

en.title: SAS Equips Over 80 A320neo Aircraft With Starlink Wi-Fi In Six Months
en.summary: SAS equips over 80 A320neo aircraft with Starlink satellite Wi-Fi within six months.
body: According to a news report published by Simple Flying, airline SAS has successfully completed the installation of Starlink satellite internet equipment on more than 80 A320neo aircraft in its fleet over a period of just six months.

The rollout of satellite links across the A320neo fleet was accomplished in record time. The upgraded connectivity allows frequent flyers to gain continuous gate-to-gate video streaming access from departure to arrival.

In addition to gate-to-gate streaming capabilities, the newly installed Starlink satellite connections provide passengers with speedy access to cloud services and online tools while on board the aircraft.

zh.title: Saab雙座戰機Gripen F首飛 巴西飛行員共同參與
zh.summary: Saab雙座戰機Gripen F於瑞典首飛，巴西空軍飛行員共同登機測試。
body: 瑞典國防航太廠商Saab於2026年8月28日成功完成了雙座戰機Gripen F的首次飛行。這架戰機於當日上午9時40分自Saab位於瑞典藍科平（Linköping）的機場起飛，並在空中停留了40分鐘，正式開啟了該機型在交付給巴西之前的空中測試階段。
本次首飛任務由Saab的主測試飛行員Jakob Högberg與巴西空軍測試飛行員Abdon de Rezende Vasconcelos中校共同執行。Saab官方聲明指出，此次飛行驗證了戰機核心系統的功能性以及初步的飛行性能表現，為後續的飛行測試奠定了基礎。

根據Saab的規劃，測試團隊接下來將進行初始生產驗收飛行，隨後進入漸進式飛行包絡線（flight envelope）的擴展階段。在此階段中，測試人員將逐步放寬並清除戰機在速度、高度、重力加速度（G值）和攻角等方面的極限。此外，雙座機型特有的戰術能力以及後座艙功能也將在測試中同步進行評估。這項測試將由Saab位於瑞典藍科平的飛行測試中心負責執行，但該公司並未透露具體的時間表，也未說明何時會向巴西空軍正式交付該戰機。
巴西是雙座Gripen F戰機的首發客戶，並深入參與了該機型的共同開發。雙方於2014年簽署的合約共涵蓋36架戰機，其中包括28架單座型Gripen E及8架雙座型Gripen F。據Saab統計，已有超過350名巴西工程師、技術人員與飛行員參與了該戰機研發、生產、飛行測試和維護的相關培訓。

此次首飛是繼2026年6月2日第一架雙座Gripen F在藍科平亮相（rollout）後的最新進展。此外，第一架在巴西組裝的單座Gripen E已於2026年3月25日在巴西航空工業（Embraer）位於加維奧培克索托（Gavião Peixoto）的工廠出廠。截至2026年6月，在28架單座機型中已有11架完成交付。目前瑞典方面透露，巴西未來可能會追加訂購約20架Gripen戰機，且Saab與巴西航空工業已於2026年7月21日簽署合作協議，將巴西的組裝線作為瑞典藍科平生產線的補充。

en.title: Saab Two-Seat Gripen F Fighter Completes First Flight with Brazilian Pilot Aboard
en.summary: Saab flew the two-seat Gripen F fighter in Sweden on August 28 with a Brazilian pilot.
body: Swedish defence manufacturer Saab successfully flew its two-seat Gripen F fighter aircraft for the first time on August 28, 2026. The aircraft took off from Saab’s airfield in Linköping, Sweden, at 09:40 local time and remained airborne for 40 minutes. This flight officially opened the airborne phase of a test campaign that must be completed before the fighter is handed over to the Brazilian Air Force.

The maiden flight was piloted by Saab chief test pilot Jakob Högberg, alongside Brazilian Air Force test pilot Lieutenant Colonel Abdon de Rezende Vasconcelos. According to a release from Saab, the flight successfully verified the functionality of the fighter's core systems as well as its initial flight performance.

Following initial production acceptance flights, the test campaign will move into progressive flight envelope expansion. This process will clear the aircraft's limits for speed, altitude, G-load, and angle of attack step by step. Parallel evaluations will also assess tactical capabilities and the rear cockpit functions unique to the two-seat configuration. The campaign will be conducted by Saab’s Flight Test Centre in Linköping, Sweden, though the company has not yet set a timeline for completion or subsequent deliveries.

Brazil is the launch customer for the Gripen F and has actively participated in its co-development. A contract signed in 2014 covers 36 aircraft, comprising 28 single-seat Gripen E and eight two-seat Gripen F fighters. Saab noted that more than 350 Brazilian engineers, technicians, and pilots have received training related to the aircraft's development, production, flight testing, and maintenance.

The test flight follows the rollout of the first Gripen F in Linköping on June 2, 2026. Meanwhile, the first Brazilian-assembled single-seat Gripen E was rolled out at Embraer's plant in Gavião Peixoto on March 25, 2026. As of June 2026, eleven of the 28 ordered Gripen E aircraft had been delivered. Sweden indicated on June 4, 2026, that Brazil might order around 20 additional Gripen fighters, with Saab and Embraer having signed a heads of agreement on July 21, 2026, to position the Gavião Peixoto line as a complement to Linköping.

zh.title: 美FAA核發華盛頓馬納薩斯機場（MNZ）商業營運許可證
zh.summary: 華盛頓馬納薩斯機場獲美FAA核發證照，將可起降商業客運航班。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）於2026年8月31日宣布，已向華盛頓馬納薩斯機場（HEF）核發 Part 139 機場營運許可證（Airport Operating Certificate），此舉將允許該機場接待特定的商業客運航空公司航班。
根據FAA官員說法，這是維吉尼亞州53年來首間獲得此營運許可證的機場。在過去五年中，FAA已在該機場投資超過4600萬美元，以支持跑道重建及未來新建飛航管制塔台等關鍵基礎設施改善計畫。

en.title: FAA Grants Part 139 Operating Certificate to Washington Manassas Airport (MNZ)
en.summary: FAA grants Washington Manassas Airport an operating certificate to allow commercial passenger airline flights.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced on August 31, 2026, that it has granted Washington Manassas Airport (MNZ) a Part 139 Airport Operating Certificate. This certification will enable the airport to accommodate scheduled commercial passenger airline operations.

According to the FAA, this marks the first time in 53 years that an airport in Virginia has received such an operating certificate. Over the past five years, the agency has invested more than $46 million at the airport to support critical infrastructure improvements, including runway rehabilitation and future air traffic control tower construction.
